title: Chintamani Library v2.4.0 — Cloud Infrastructure
releaseNotes: MAJOR: Entire system moved to cloud — no laptop dependency anymore
Cloud Backend: NestJS now hosted on Render.com (always available 24/7)
Cloud Database: PostgreSQL moved to Neon.tech cloud (all data safe, always online)
Cloud Storage: Member selfies and documents now stored on Cloudinary CDN
Works from anywhere: Admin portal accessible from any device, any network
QR codes now point to production cloud URL (not localhost)
App can work even when laptop is completely powered off
Branch separation maintained: Mehdawal and Khalilabad fully isolated in cloud
